The center is the black point:
\[
(h,k)=(1,2).
\]

The red point \((3,5)\) lies on the circle, so the radius is
\[
r=\sqrt{(3-1)^2+(5-2)^2}
=\sqrt{2^2+3^2}
=\sqrt{13}.
\]

Using the standard form of a circle,
\[
(x-h)^2+(y-k)^2=r^2,
\]
we get
\[
\boxed{(x-1)^2+(y-2)^2=13}.
\]
